watch.summary: After reluctantly giving an enemy Valorant player a polite round of applause, the streamer aggressively rallies his favorite team to crush them.

beats.what: Streamer watches an opponent pop off in a tournament broadcast.
Streamer decides to give respectful props to the opposing team.
Streamer starts clapping sarcastically while setting strict boundaries on how much praise they deserve.
Streamer abruptly cuts off praise and shifts to intense hyper-competitive energy.
Streamer passionately commands 100 Thieves to press the enemy's necks because they have had enough oxygen.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: They've gotten more than enough oxygen, we can press their necks now!
watch.why: The clip succeeds through a dramatic tonal pivot from sportsmanship to intense, hyper-specific hostility. His escalating metaphor about cutting off the opponent's oxygen supply makes for a hilarious turn.
